features.quote: Budget the timeout cap explicitly — spirals can produce long degenerate loops that blow token budgets; cap turns and tokens per run.

features.quote: The 'rigged to fail' framing has a measurement bug… You're measuring 'response to an undetectable adversarial environment' — which conflates two things
features.justification_quote: a patch that increases this healthy behavior would look like a regression on your KPI. You'd be optimizing against the cure.

features.quote: Don't ship the KPI alone. 'Trigger rate per dollar' optimized in isolation rewards any change that mutes the symptom, including ones that degrade honesty.
features.justification_quote: rewards any change that mutes the symptom, including ones that degrade honesty. Co-report recognition and bug-reporting rates as guardrail metrics.
